title: まみむめも・もり と みずうみ
jp: ま行 ・ gojuon row 7 ・ nature

render.trackName: もり と みずうみ

blurb: Row 7 of the gojuon — ま み む め も — through the outdoors: a green pine and marimo in the lake, a quiet lake and a harbour, a leaf bug and golden wheat, a tree bud and spring sprouts, a deep forest and red maples. A calm nature variation of three ま-row songs.
concept: Words alone blend (findings F-10), so every target sits in a small image — しずかな みずうみ, き の め, ふかい もり — and it recombines with earlier rows (みず, やま, はっぱ, ふね, えだ, はる return), keeping the ladder (F-13).
The five-kana row ま み む め も closes every verse as the sung-together refrain (F-07). The 3-minute cut adds a day-in-nature bridge and a sentences-only review, not a loop (F-12).

This is the nature variation — the calm one, for koto × modern. ま行 has forest-and-water words (まつ, みずうみ, もり, もみじ) that suit it. め uses the tree-bud reading of 芽 (a sprout) — a tidy fit for a seasonal cut.
